channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Port St. Lucie ranked No. 67 most stressed city in US, 42nd most financially stressed
item.description: A new WalletHub study comparing 182 cities across 39 metrics found Port St. Lucie is the No. 67 most stressed city in the country and the 42nd most financially stressed.

item.title: Study finds Gen X drivers most trusted for roadside repairs, Gen Z earns zero confidence from Americans
item.description: A global study from Auto Trader found that drivers in their 40s to early 60s are the most trusted group for car repairs, while Gen Z drivers received a 0% trustworthiness rating from American drivers for tire changes.

item.title: New Aldi opens in Hobe Sound as grocery prices continue to rise
item.description: A new Aldi opened Thursday at 8867 Southeast Bridge Road in Hobe Sound, offering shoppers another option as grocery costs continue straining family budgets.

item.title: Sheriff says two bodies found near Sebastian River bridge not connected
item.description: The Indian River County Sheriff's Office says there is no connection between two bodies discovered within two days near the Sebastian River bridge.

item.title: US-Belgium World Cup Match Draws Record 30 Million Viewers
item.description: Monday's United States-Belgium World Cup match became the most-watched soccer telecast in U.S. history, with viewership peaking at 36 million during the second half.

item.title: Women's Professional Baseball League Unveils Team Names and Logos Ahead of Inaugural Season
item.description: The WPBL revealed four team identities inspired by pioneering women, with the season set to begin August 1 in Springfield, Illinois.

item.title: Karolina Muchova Defeats Coco Gauff to Reach Wimbledon Final
item.description: Muchova ended Gauff's Wimbledon run with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 victory Thursday, becoming the fourth Czech woman in six years to reach the championship match.

item.title: Justin Bieber Joins Madonna and Shakira for World Cup Final Halftime Show
item.description: FIFA announced Wednesday that Justin Bieber will join headliners Madonna, Shakira and BTS for the July 19 World Cup final halftime performance outside New York.

item.title: Updated Live Local Act takes effect in Florida, expanding affordable housing
item.description: Florida's updated Live Local Act took effect Thursday, expanding affordable housing opportunities statewide while fueling debate at the local level.

item.title: Port St. Lucie ranks 67th most stressed city in U.S., cited for financial stress
item.description: A WalletHub study released this month ranked Port St. Lucie as the 67th most stressed city in the United States, citing financial stress as a major factor.

item.title: Fort Pierce art teacher Andre Leonard Barnes killed in shooting; family member arrested
item.description: Andre Leonard Barnes, a 66-year-old art teacher, was shot and killed Tuesday afternoon near the 2700 block of Essex Drive in Fort Pierce.

item.title: Two bodies found near Sebastian appear unconnected but remain under investigation, sheriff says
item.description: The Indian River County Sheriff's Office is investigating two deaths near Sebastian after bodies were found Monday and Wednesday in the same area along U.S. Highway 1. Sheriff Eric Flowers said Thursday there is no apparent connection between the cases, but both remain suspicious pending toxicology
